results.finding: sections, unit counts and unit forms match the spec

The intro reader predicted all ten body sections in the roadmap order, the three kinds of evidence (Larkfield case, dated provider documentation, side-by-side comparison) and the plain, attributing tone. Not predicted: the names of the three designs and that the chapter reports what nobody has re-described, which the draft roadmap does not announce.

52 of 52 outline summaries match the controlling idea of the aligned spec paragraph, in spec order. One partial: the draft unit for p17 leaves out that each dated version contains a small set of incompatible changes (recorded under flow_is_followable).

results.draft_locus: Adyen's Documented Model: A Number in Each URL and a Published Lifecycle ¶5
results.quote: Adyen's upgrade page says the lifecycle state of each version is shown in its API Explorer, an interactive reference.
results.finding: The paragraph opens on what Adyen has not published about serving versions and then turns to where an integrator looks up a lifecycle state; the second does not fall under the topic sentence, and the closing sentence returns to the first. The spec joins the two in one controlling idea. (The other unit the outliner flagged, ¶4, holds one idea plus one trailing sentence of fact and is not failed.)
All 42 body paragraphs tie to the supporting claim their section declares (C1 to C5); the recommendation against copying the mechanism ties to C2 through its stated price.
All 5 tables, 3 figures and the block quotations are introduced or followed by a sentence or caption saying what they show; each spec evidence item is used with its point stated.

51 of 51 boundaries (10 section openings, 40 paragraph boundaries, the conclusion) express the declared relationship; the weakest are the openings of the scene and of the practice section, which rely on the heading and "At Larkfield" for the pick-up.

The introduction links to the previous chapter, gives the incident, states a disputable claim and a roadmap; none of the weak patterns.

The conclusion sorts what is established, what depends and the author's position, then questions and a hand-off; it does not open with "in conclusion", end on a rephrased thesis alone or hold body evidence.

The synthesis bullet states what no single section states (opposite-looking designs allocate the same debt and differ in who announces the due date) and says why it matters (set your own date or a dependency upgrade sets it).

results.draft_locus: What to Take Away ¶3
results.quote: On Stripe I set my own, because otherwise a dependency upgrade sets it for me.
results.finding: The conclusion never returns to Larkfield's March 2026 upgrade or to the idempotency key as a memory the provider keeps; this generic mention of a dependency upgrade is the nearest it comes, and the opening question "what happens when that memory ends?" is left unanswered. The spec declares the callback but gives it to no conclusion paragraph.

The reader said the newer SDK carries its own API version and moves every request across the releases in between, and would check the current and target versions, the separately set webhook endpoint version, the breaking changes against the fields code and exports read, and a sandbox replay before merging: all elements of the expected answer.
The reader derived the three expected obligations: parse leniently, track the lifecycle state and upgrade inside the notice period, upgrade each API separately because each has its own counter.

results.draft_locus: Introduction callout (FAILURE PATTERNS, third bullet)
results.quote: Stripe's machinery for serving every old version answers a problem of scale
results.finding: The sorting half of the criterion is met (the table in the 2023-2024 section sorts the 2017 claims into confirmed, replaced and not re-described), and the 2017 post carries its age in the body, the comparison table and the conclusion. This callout uses the 2017 claim with no date or age and in the present tense, as if Stripe serves every old version today, which the chapter itself says is not known.
